answer: The ember test I would run is Signed brass band membership with rehearsal log: rehearsals attended weekly for four years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so rehearsals attended weekly for four years stays private; the juniper is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the garden of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
